Synthetic test document — fictional patient, generated for software testing. Not a real report.

This fixture deliberately carries the identifier in running prose rather than in a
labelled field, to exercise the documented limit of regex redaction. The parser is
expected to MISS the name here. That is the point of the fixture.

Lakeside Regional Genetics Service
Clinic letter — genetics follow-up

Dear Dr Fictional,

Thank you for referring Jaziah Okonkwo-Vasquez, who I saw in clinic last week with his
mother. As you know, Jaziah is six and has an autism diagnosis made at age three, with
associated language delay.

The exome sequencing we sent in January has now returned. It identified a de novo
pathogenic variant in ARID1B, NM_020732.3:c.4propagate — apologies, the correct notation
is NM_020732.3:c.4318C>T (p.Arg1440Ter), heterozygous. This is consistent with a
diagnosis of Coffin-Siris syndrome.

I have explained the result to Jaziah's mother and we discussed what it does and does not
tell us. I will see them again in six months.

Date of report: 24 February 2026

Yours sincerely,
Dr A. Notreal
Consultant Clinical Geneticist
